brief: Hype party track for my brother's 18th: loud, slangy, fun.
title: Eighteen, No Cap
style: Hip hop pop, 98 BPM, male vocal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Yo, my little bro just levelled up tonight,
eighteen candles and the speakers hitting right,
he still can't park but he's legally grown,
Mum's crying in the kitchen on the phone.

[Chorus]
Eighteen, no cap, turn it up,
eighteen, no cap, raise your cup,
the man, the myth, the birthday king,
eighteen, no cap, now everybody sing.

[Verse 2]
Remember when he cried about a broken toy,
now he's got a beard and still acts like a boy,
we roast him all night 'cause we love him like that,
happy birthday, bro, that's facts.

[Chorus]
Eighteen, no cap, turn it up,
eighteen, no cap, raise your cup,
the man, the myth, the birthday king,
eighteen, no cap, now everybody sing.
reason: Loud, slangy and fun as the brief asks; on topic, catchy repeated chorus.
